title: Tracking F&B outlet closures and support for independent operators
asked: Mr Saktiandi Supaat asked whether the ministry tracks F&B outlet closures from 2015 to 2025, the breakdown between standalone outlets, local chains and foreign chains, common reasons for closures, and whether measures exist to preserve local area heritage through a mix of food and retail offerings.
response: ACRA tracks and publishes information on the formation and cessation of all business entities, but the Government does not track the breakdown between standalone outlets, local chains and foreign chains. The F&B sector is highly competitive due to low barriers of entry, high product substitutability and rapidly shifting consumer preferences. Between 2015 and 2025, there was a net increase of 42% in F&B entities, with formations outpacing cessations in most years. The Government supports local heritage through the Inter-agency Task Force for Heritage Businesses and Enterprise Singapore initiatives such as New Bahru.

key_points.point: ACRA tracks and publishes information on the formation and cessation of all business entities.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) tracks and publishes information on the formation and cessation of all business entities.

key_points.point: The Government does not track the breakdown of cessations between standalone outlets, local chains and foreign chains.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Government does not track the breakdown of cessations between standalone outlets, local chains and foreign chains.

key_points.point: The food services sector is highly competitive due to low barriers of entry, high product substitutability and rapidly shifting consumer preferences.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The food services sector is highly competitive due to low barriers of entry, high product substitutability and rapidly shifting consumer preferences.

key_points.point: Between 2015 and 2025, there was a net increase of 42% in F&B entities, with formations outpacing cessations in most years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Between 2015 and 2025, there has been a net increase of 42% in the number of food and beverages (F&B) entities, with formations outpacing cessations in most years.

key_points.point: The Government values Singapore's local heritage and takes steps to preserve and sustain it in the F&B landscape.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Government values Singapore's local heritage and takes steps to preserve and sustain it in our F&B landscape.

key_points.point: Enterprise Singapore supports initiatives that protect and enhance local heritage through curated F&B and retail experiences.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Enterprise Singapore also supports initiatives that protect and enhance local heritage through curated F&B and retail experiences.

key_points.point: New Bahru is a creative cluster blending heritage conservation with contemporary local F&B and lifestyle businesses.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: An example is, of course, New Bahru, a creative cluster that blends heritage conservation with a curated mix of contemporary local F&B and lifestyle businesses.

key_points.point: The Government does not track the granular data and will take the suggestion into consideration.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We do not track those data, so we will take his suggestion into consideration.

key_points.point: Enterprise Singapore works closely with heartland shops and SMEs on a variety of programmes, in addition to SME Centres.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: in addition to the SME Centres, Enterprise Singapore works very closely with heartland shops as well as SMEs on a variety of programmes.

key_points.point: New measures to help SMEs were announced in Budget 2023, 2024 and 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Every year, in Budget 2023, 2024, 2025, we have announced new measures to help SMEs.

key_points.point: The food services productivity report allows SMEs to benchmark themselves against peers to see best practices.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we have the food services productivity report, which allows for SMEs to benchmark themselves with their peers to see what are the best practices

key_points.point: The Food X Programme enables SMEs to outsource operationally difficult or expensive parts of their operations.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we have the Food X Programme, for example, that enables them to maybe outsource some of the more operationally difficult or expensive parts of their operations.

key_points.point: The Process Optimisation Programme helps SMEs adopt new technology to streamline their businesses.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we also have a Process Optimisation Programme which helps them to adopt new technology to help to streamline their businesses.

key_points.point: The ministry works closely with trade associations such as the Restaurant Association of Singapore and the Singapore Retailers Association.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we work very closely with the trade associations and commerce; for example, the Restaurant Association of Singapore and the Singapore Retailers Association.

left_open: A breakdown of the common reasons for F&B outlet closures.
supplementary: Requests for granular closure data, impact on independent operators, and proactive support from SME Centres.
